meta.name: finance-based-pricing-advisor
meta.description: Evaluate pricing changes using ARPU, conversion, churn risk, NRR, and payback. Use when deciding whether a pricing move should ship.

copy.tagline: 评估定价变化对收入指标的影响，辅助决策是否推出
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你的团队需要基于数据做出定价调整决策
copy.tagline_en: Evaluate pricing changes on key metrics to support go/no-go decisions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team needs data-driven pricing decisions

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会询问您定价变更的细节，然后分析ARPU、转化、流失、NRR和CAC回收期的影响，最后给出实施、A/B测试或修改建议。
howto.when: 当您考虑定价变更（如提价、新增层级、折扣等）并需要评估财务可行性时触发。

say.text: 我们考虑对新客户提价15%，帮我评估财务影响。
say.note: Claude会引导您填写当前指标并给出分析。

say.text: 评估添加高级订阅层级的收入影响。
say.note: Claude会询问新层级价格和预期升级率。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude asks for details of your pricing change, then analyzes impact on ARPU, conversion, churn, NRR, and CAC payback, and recommends implement, A/B test, or modify.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you are considering a pricing change (e.g., price increase, new tier, discount) and need a financial viability assessment.

say_en.text: We're considering a 15% price increase for new customers. Evaluate the financial impact.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you to input current metrics and provide analysis.

say_en.text: Assess the revenue impact of adding a premium tier.
say_en.note: Claude will ask about the new tier price and expected upgrade rate.
